verdict.rationale: Brex's API reference appears to be generated from OpenAPI: the webhooks docs sit under a /openapi/ path and are served as markdown (brex-docs-20). Postman usage is documented (brex-docs-22), and an llms.txt index is live (brex-probe-1). However, a probe of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) returned 404 for all of them (brex-probe-2), so no directly downloadable spec file is confirmed. Missing for 10: a confirmed downloadable OpenAPI/JSON/YAML spec URL, documentation explaining how to download the spec or Postman collection, and independent corroboration that the spec is usable by agents.
